value.text:
q28.

s3presign runner — started by `Server.Start`; runs once immediately, then every 12 hours via a `time.Ticker`; stopped by server shutdown context. (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)

Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` provides cron-based scheduling, but the server never constructs or starts it. The `memopayload` runner is also not started; its rebuild function is called synchronously by API handlers. (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`)
